question: What is the attendance requirement to sit in the Major exam?
answer: According to the revised policy, a student is expected to have full attendance in each course unless the student takes a leave of absence for valid medical or bonafide reasons. In any case, the attendance of a student should not fall below 75% in a course. [Source: Circular: Amendment in the Attendance Policy (08 July 2024; from Sem I AY 2024-25), p. 1]

question: How many Open Elective credits do I need to earn in order to get a B.Tech. degree?
answer: You need to earn 12 Open Elective credits to get a B.Tech. degree. [Source: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering UG Curriculum (2026 onwards), p. 5]

question: What are the minimum and maximum credits a UG student can register for in a semester?
answer:
The minimum number of credits a UG student can register for in a semester is 12, and the maximum number of credits is 25. 

[Source: regulations_ug_2020_bioscience_copy.pdf, p. 19]

question: What is the maximum duration allowed to complete the B.Tech. program?
answer: The maximum duration allowed to complete the B.Tech. program is 14 registered semesters. [Source: regulations_web_2019_onwards.txt, p. 14]

question: Within how many days must I apply for a make-up examination and to whom?
answer:
You must apply for a make-up examination within 10 days from the date of the examination missed to the Dean (Academics) through the course instructor. 

[Source: regulations_pg_2022_onwards.pdf, p. 13]

question: How many days of short leave can a UG student take on medical grounds?
answer:
A UG student can take a maximum of 10 days of short leave on medical grounds. 

[Source: regulations_web_2019_onwards.txt, p. 17]

question: How many grade points is an A- grade worth?
answer: An A- grade is worth 9 grade points. [Source: regulations_web_2019_onwards.txt, p. 7]

question: How many credits must a general category B.Tech student earn by the end of the second semester to continue in the program?
answer: A general category B.Tech student must earn a minimum of 80 credits by the end of the second semester to continue in the program. [Source: Academic Regulations (students enrolled from July 2020 onwards), p. 17]

question: What is the maximum number of credits I can register for in the summer term?
answer: The maximum number of credits a student can register for in the summer term is 16 for Executive (Accelerated) M.Tech. students, 9 for Executive (Normal) M.Tech. students, 6 for Executive (Slow-Paced) M.Tech. students, and 9 for Full-time (Regular) M.Tech. students. [Source: Rules and Regulations for PG Programmes (enrolled from July 2022 onwards), p. 21]

question: Is branch change allowed for B.Tech students admitted in 2026?
answer: Branch change is not allowed for B.Tech students admitted in 2026. According to the B.Tech Registration and Academic Session FAQ (branch change discontinued from AY 2026-27), "No Branch Change post second year onwards." [Source: B.Tech Registration and Academic Session FAQ (branch change discontinued from AY 2026-27), p. 2]

question: What happens if a student is absent for four or more weeks in a semester?
answer: If a student is absent for four or more weeks in a semester, their registration will result in automatic semester withdrawal for all the courses. [Source: Circular: Amendment in the Attendance Policy (08 July 2024; from Sem I AY 2024-25), p. 1]
